Financial products (not insurance)

Pensions and Retirement Planning in Kenya

Pension schemes and annuities help people replace income in retirement. They are provided by regulated pension administrators and insurers. This page is general information. Chestnut’s distribution role and authority for these products must be confirmed before launch.

Speak to an advisor
This is not insurance. Chestnut does not manufacture, manage or guarantee this product. It is provided by a licensed provider under that provider’s terms, and returns or benefits are not guaranteed. [CONFIRM before launch: Chestnut’s authority and provider arrangements for this product, and add the provider disclosures]

What to know

  • Employer-sponsored schemes and individual pension plans
  • Annuities that convert a lump sum into regular retirement income
  • Tax treatment that depends on the product and current law

Who needs it

  • Employers designing a retirement benefit
  • Individuals planning for retirement

Common risks

Underestimating retirement needs

Many people save too little too late.

Product complexity

Charges, investment choices and tax rules differ by provider.

Important considerations and exclusions

  • Pensions are regulated separately from general insurance.
  • Get advice from an appropriately authorised adviser for your own circumstances.

What affects the outcome

  • Contribution level
  • Time to retirement
  • Provider and charges

What to prepare

  • Age and retirement goals
  • Existing pension arrangements

How Chestnut can help

We can explain the options in plain language and tell you what Chestnut can and cannot assist with.
